instruction: Navigate to the drug interactions checker on Drugs.com.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from the drugs.com homepage to the drug interactions checker page. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify the active URL matches the expected interactions page. This is a simple navigation task similar in complexity to the original natural products database navigation.
metadata.verification_notes: The drug interactions checker is a standard feature on drugs.com. Task requires agent to find and navigate to this tool from the homepage.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_url_from_accessTree can extract the active tab URL from the accessibility tree
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_active_tab properly compares the actual URL against the expected URL using compare_urls
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the exact requirement - whether the user navigated to the drug interactions checker page
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts URL string -> Metric compares with expected URL
Expected value is semantically correct: https://www.drugs.com/drug_interactions.html is the actual URL for the drug interactions checker
Metric handles both string URLs and dict format (with 'url' field) correctly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor consideration: The goto_prefix 'https://www.' could potentially cause URL duplication if the accessibility tree already includes 'www.' in the address bar text. However, this is likely handled correctly by the compare_urls function during URL normalization.
